notes: Sources: thaneweb.com per-route directional timetable pages, citybustimetable.com per-route stop-by-stop timetables (route 10, 11, 13, 16, 16A), and Moovit/BusKosh for route inventory. Moovit reports the full TMT network as ~142 routes / 941 stops; this feed faithfully encodes 6 routes (10, 11, 13, 16, 16A, 22) for which stop-by-stop sequences AND clock times were actually published, so it is a representative subset, NOT the whole network. All stop NAMES and ORDER are taken directly from the sources (never invented). Departure clock times at the origin are the real published first/last/interval values from the timetable pages; intermediate stop times are the sources' own ~2 min/stop offsets. citybustimetable explicitly states its intermediate per-stop times are estimated. Coordinates: major hubs (Thane Station 19.18611,72.97583; Vartak Nagar 19.20826,72.96101; Majiwada 19.2137,72.9903; Cadbury Junction, Kapurbawdi, Yeoor) use looked-up landmark coordinates; many minor stops are interpolated along the known corridor between anchored hubs and are approximate (good to a few hundred m). No stop is included without textual evidence. Each route has one representative outbound trip (published times) plus a reversed inbound trip (times shifted, sequence reversed). Service assumed daily (sources state 'operational every day'). Confidence 0.5: stop names/order and origin times are well-grounded and real; intermediate times and many minor-stop coordinates are approximate, and only ~6 of ~142 routes are covered.
